## See what the data can show

[Research equity · Marburg virus]{.card-num}

### Who leads Marburg virus research?

Gender, local leadership, funding and WHO research priorities in 684 papers, 2008–2023.

[Open the explorer](dashboards/marburg-equity.qmd){.card-link}

::: {.card-cx .reveal}
[Research funding · phage therapy]{.card-num}

### Who funds phage therapy research?

25 years of research grants by country, funder, topic and year.

[Open the explorer](dashboards/phage-funding.qmd){.card-link}

::: {.card-cx .reveal}
[Open access · Africa]{.card-num}

### Open access in Africa, 2002–2021

[Open the explorer](dashboards/oa-africa.qmd){.card-link}

### Immune checkpoint therapy patents

## Who we help

[Every project starts from one question you need answered. We bring the data, the method and the reading of a scientist.]{.lead}
:::

::: {.grid .grid-2}
::: {.card-cx .reveal}
[01]{.card-num}

### NGOs, funders and health programs

Understand a health topic before you act or fund, and see who is left out.

- Evidence snapshots on one clear question
- Landscape reports with an equity lens
- Living dashboards for your topic

[Clear evidence, delivered](services.qmd#organizations){.card-link}
:::

::: {.card-cx .reveal}
[02]{.card-num}

### Biotech and investors

See who is researching and inventing what, where the space is crowded, and where it is open.

- Landscape reports from publications, trials and patents
- Research and competitor mapping
- Living dashboards to follow a field

[Landscape reports](services.qmd#landscape){.card-link}
:::

::: {.card-cx .reveal}
[03]{.card-num}

### Researchers and students

Learn to make the data of your health topic speak: a dataset, a dashboard and an article.

- Discovery workshops and bootcamps
- One-to-one coaching on your project
- Training for teams and labs

[Learn to do it yourself](services.qmd#researchers){.card-link}
:::

::: {.card-cx .reveal}
[04]{.card-num}

### African research partners

Lead studies on the health problems that matter where you work, with data and methods you keep.

- Research mapping for grant applications
- Co-led studies and shared authorship
- Training in English and French

[Research in Africa](projects/research-in-africa.qmd){.card-link}
:::
